description: Pure allocation table test covers item, service, and whole-quote fixed/percentage targets with exact cent conservation.
Mixed-cadence service allocation test proves proportional recurring/one-time split and deterministic rounding.
Guard test covers optional unselected items, removed targets, zero bases, and oversized discounts.
Draft editor regression proves target and item edits immediately recompute correct totals.
DB-backed calculation integration proves positive discount persistence, exact totals, and save/reload behavior.
DB-backed guard integration proves unmatched targets do not corrupt saved quote or item financials.
Adapter regression reproduces $25+$35 less $5+$5 as $50 recurring with one-time unchanged and legacy false/null cadence.
Adapter compatibility test covers multiple discounts and service/product/location/phase collections without double application.
Browser smoke creates Fixed Discount > Specific Service, saves/reopens, and verifies preview rows and totals.
Generate and inspect standard and duplicated/custom grouped PDFs, comparing recurring, one-time, discount, and overall figures.
